verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI agents and evals are defined in Python code, so automations can be versioned with ordinary source control, though the docs only imply this. Logfire evals let you compare a candidate against a baseline case by case, which offers some review before a change ships. Missing for 10: any documented versioning of agents/automations, a review workflow for automation changes, rollback to prior versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
